predictions.claim: By end-2028, T1-classified seed companies in the four markets will show a Series A graduation rate at least 1.5x the unregulated cohort, observable from public Crunchbase and Dealroom data.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if T1 cohort Series A graduation rate ≥ 1.5× unregulated cohort across the four markets, measured on the 2028-12-31 dataset re-query. Resolved NO if < 1.5×. Pending if data unavailable.

predictions.claim: By end-2028, at least three of the five regulator-anchored compliance frameworks (TGA digital health, FSANZ food traceability, MAS AI risk, PMDA digital-therapeutic pathway, Medsafe WAND) will publish operational compliance frameworks materially in their final form.
predictions.source: Public regulator publications across AU, JP, NZ, SG
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if 3+ of the five named frameworks have published their final operational compliance documentation by 2028-12-31. Resolved NO if ≤ 2.

predictions.claim: By end-2027, the cumulative T1-to-unregulated funding premium will widen from 2.12x (2026) to at least 2.30x at Series D+ in the four target markets.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if Series D+ cumulative funding premium ≥ 2.30× on the 2027 re-query. Resolved NO if < 2.30×.

predictions.claim: By end-2028, at least two additional named acquisitions of developed-APAC regulated-technology companies by NA or EMEA strategic acquirers will close at EV at or above $100M.
predictions.source: Primary-source verified exit dataset; ASX, TSE, NZX, SGX filings
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if 2+ named acquisitions meeting the EV threshold close by 2028-12-31. Each must have a primary-source filing trail (exchange disclosure, 8-K, or equivalent).

predictions.claim: By end-2027, at least one of MAS, PMDA, or AEMO will publish a mandatory operational AI risk framework that creates direct compliance-software demand observable in public procurement notices.
predictions.source: Public regulator publications and procurement notices
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if any of MAS, PMDA, or AEMO publishes a mandatory framework AND a public procurement notice referencing the framework appears within 12 months of publication.
